title: The Click at the Civic Theater and Guys and Dolls
summary: On a new reel, he explains the nickname given to the show-band clique and begins a Guys and Dolls story at the Civic Theater.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
